claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: BP-897 is a D3-preferring dopamine receptor partial agonist that at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill cancer cells through its annotated dopaminergic activity; any antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect a non-selective aminergic/off-target or physicochemical (cationic amphiphilic) effect rather than a defined cytotoxic mechanism.
